Attached is a working workbook (QH_joint_pipeline_sheet.xlsx) with the current queue from Sarah's team — I pasted the top 12 pursuits into the first tab and added columns for co-sell readiness, marketplace listing status, and suggested Redwood play.

Can Lauren confirm which of these are likely to be eligible for Co-sell badge review this quarter? And Sarah, can you add the estimated procurement timeline (signed PO target) and the top technical blocker for each line?

Proposed agenda for a 30-minute sync (suggest Wed 1/20 14:00 PT or Thu 1/21 10:00 PT):
- 5m quick intros and success criteria for QuantifyHealth
- 10m triage: which 3 deals to prioritize for GCP co-sell + marketplace listing fast-track
- 10m action items: owners for technical readiness, marketplace listing artifacts, and proposed PRD for packaging
- 5m scheduling follow-ups (handoff to Channel team / Redwood SE)

I'm happy to run the meeting and supply a short playbook doc (play-queue-prioritization.pdf) with suggested carrier waves (billing/legal touchpoints, needed attachments for listing).

Thanks — please confirm a time and I'll send an invite with the deck.

Best,
Irene

Quick notes inline:
- Line 1 (QH-Cardio): procurement cycle ~45–60 days, technical blocker is HSM key exchange for PHI — we can prioritize a security workshop and involve our Compliance SME.
- Line 4 (QH-Analytics): good candidate for marketplace: containerized inference + managed infra; procurement is vendor consolidation so timeline is 60–90 days.
- Line 7 (QH-ClinicalSearch): small PoC; could be accelerated if we bundle a credits offer.

Wed 1/20 14:00 PT works for me. If you can run the meeting and share the playbook, I'll bring GCP's checklist for co-sell eligibility and the channel ops contact.
